method: read-only static search and targeted source inspection; no launchers executed

findings.classification: bounded only for app workers routed through this module
findings.evidence: Windows attaches QProcess child to a Job Object with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE; optional process-count, process-memory, CPU-time, and CPU-rate limits. Linux strong mode uses bubblewrap; resource mode wraps with systemd-run --user --scope and can set MemoryMax, TasksMax, and CPUQuota. This generic builder does not set MemorySwapMax or OOMPolicy=kill.

findings.classification: no cgroup or Job Object at server launch
findings.evidence: Local server and WSL paths use subprocess.Popen; cleanup terminates/waits/kills process but no resource boundary is applied.

findings.classification: no cgroup or Job Object at server launch
findings.evidence: subprocess.Popen starts each model server; cleanup terminates/waits/kills process.

findings.classification: no cgroup or Job Object in launcher
findings.evidence: execs the Python Strata server directly.

findings.classification: no Job Object association visible at server launch
findings.evidence: Maintained evaluation scripts launch inference servers with Start-Process; inspected entrypoints do not attach the child tree to a Job Object or apply a job memory cap.

Q35 supervisor and worker use system-manager transient units in background.slice with finite MemoryMax, MemorySwapMax, OOMPolicy=kill, and KillMode=control-group; prior CPU-only synthetic OOM regression contained the worker and preserved controller/Codex.

decision: Do not generalize Q35/Q37 containment to all evaluation launchers. Keep P0 open pending a shared cross-platform runner and regression evidence.
